annotations.title: Add a file from a link

description: Puts a PDF at a public address on the person’s XipFax draft: XipFax fetches it from the link, which must answer with the PDF itself, and reads its pages. Answers the document, ready to send, with its pages; refused, saying why, where XipFax can’t fetch it, or the PDF is locked, unreadable or takes the fax past the pages a fax may hold, and then nothing is added. For a file on the person’s own disk, use add_fax_file. Give send_fax its id.

name.description: Its name, such as its file’s: 255 characters at most.

url.description: Where XipFax fetches it from: an https link to a public address that answers with the PDF itself, 40 MB at most, within 15 seconds. XipFax follows no redirect.

name: add_fax_file_from_url

name.description: Its name, as it was added.

page_count.description: Its pages, once XipFax has read it; null while it uploads.

status.description: `uploading` until XipFax has read it back, then `ready`. An open set: read what you know.

title: Add a file from a link
